artifacts.summary: Two-phase plan adding a sixth session_liveness() reason 'dead-pid-within-grace' for a confirmably-dead pid at or below SESSION_REGISTRY_DEAD_PID_MIN. Phase 1 carries the kill -0 result forward into the ladder's fallback branch, updates the in-file docstring, and adds reason-string assertions to test-session-registry.sh (new case 5a, extended Case 6 dry-run) and test-conflict-predicate.sh (new case 4.2b proving the contend-set is unchanged) with a required falsifiability check. Phase 2 reconciles five doc claims in context/patterns/task-lock.md, the batch-admit-schema.md schema row, and the orchestrate-batch-admit.sh header comment (an explicit file_scope addition), then redeploys and runs the full gate. cmd_session_list, cmd_session_reap, and file-scope-overlap.sh are explicit non-goals since their wildcard defaults already preserve the required live:true/no-reap verdict.
